//: Copy to ~/.suber/config.json (mode 600, folder 700). Every field can also be set with a SUBER_* env var, which wins. Keep the API key out of this file: the launcher passes it as SUBER_API_KEY from the Keychain (see README).
//model: Fallback for any tier left unset.
//promptCaching: Caches the system prompt and each worker's history between its turns. Keeps history whole, so toolResultWindow only applies when this is off.
//usageLog: One JSONL line of token usage per tool call; read it with `bun run src/index.ts usage`. "" turns it off.
//pricing: Optional USD per million tokens by model, merged over the built-in table, for usage estimates.
//maxIterationsPerAgent: Tool-loop rounds per worker. A big audit can run out at 12; split it or raise this.
//requestsPerMinute: Client-side cap so a fan-out self-paces under your API rate limit. 0 = off.
//guidance: Appended to every tool description: when to offload, which folders to use, when to stop.
guidance: Use only for read-only, self-contained jobs inside one folder. Always pass workspaceRoot as an absolute path.
//deniedRoots: Folders workers may never be pointed at, inside, or above. `~/` expands to home.
